test_name: Verify Filtering Women Products by Price Range and Adding to Cart
description: This test verifies that users can filter products in the Women category by price range, view the results, and add a product to the cart.
steps: Navigate to the Women category page.
Locate the 'Min price' input field and enter a value of 50.
Locate the 'Max price' input field and enter a value of 150.
Click the 'FILTER' button to apply the price filter.
Verify that the product list updates to reflect the selected price range.
Select a product, such as 'Blue Denim Jeans', from the filtered results.
Click on the product link to view its details.
Verify that the product detail page displays the correct product information, including price.
Locate and click the 'Add to Cart' button on the product detail page.
Navigate to the cart page to verify the product has been added.
Ensure the cart displays the correct product name, quantity, and price.
expected_results: Products are filtered correctly based on the price range.
The selected product's detail page displays accurate information.
The product is successfully added to the cart.
The cart displays the correct product details, including name, quantity, and price.
edge_cases: Entering non-numeric values in the price range fields.
Leaving one or both price range fields empty and clicking 'FILTER'.
Selecting a product that is out of stock.
Clicking 'FILTER' without entering a price range.
Network issues causing the product list to fail to update after applying the filter.
data_requirements: A product catalog with varying prices in the Women category.
At least one product priced between 50 and 150.
A product detail page for 'Blue Denim Jeans'.
An empty cart for the test user.
User permissions to add items to the cart.
dependencies: The Women category page must be accessible.
The price filter functionality must be implemented and operational.
The product detail page must be functional with an 'Add to Cart' button.
api_interactions: Check the API call that fetches filtered products.
Monitor the API call for adding the product to the cart.
Verify the API response for cart details.
performance_metrics: Time taken to update the product list after applying the filter.
Latency in loading the product detail page.
Response time for the 'Add to Cart' API call.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the price filter fields are accessible via keyboard navigation.
Verify that the 'Add to Cart' button is screen-reader friendly.
Check for appropriate ARIA labels on the product filter form.
